name: update_kms_issuer_policy
description:
Update an existing KMS issuer policy's environments or token claims.

CLI fallback on MCP failure (partial): vercel api /v1/kms/issuers/{issuerId}/policies/{kind}/{policyKey} --method PATCH. Fill placeholders from inputs.

environments.description: The environments for the project grant policy. Each entry is a system environment (production, preview, development) or a custom environment ID (env_...).

anyOf.description: The claims that KMS should include in signed JWTs for this policy. Pass null to remove them.

slug.description: Team slug to use for this operation. Use instead of teamId.

teamId.description: Team ID to use for this operation.
